title: The Harvard-Oxford cortical atlas, lateralised: 48 cortical areas a hemisphere (gyri, poles, opercula and divisions) at 25 % probability, on the MNI 152 ICBM 2009c asymmetric template at 1 mm
provider: Harvard Center for Morphometric Analysis, distributed with FSL (Oxford); resampled to the 2009c template and served by TemplateFlow
credit: Gyri: Harvard-Oxford cortical atlas (Makris et al. 2006; Desikan et al. 2006)
format: NIfTI-1, gzipped, uint8 label values 1-96 on the 1 mm grid of the 2009c template: value v is FSL's lateralised index v - 1, so that odd values are left and even right, in the order of FSL's HarvardOxford-Cortical-Lateralized.xml (frontal pole, insular cortex, superior frontal gyrus, ... occipital pole). The names are transcribed in domains/neuroscience/js/brain.js and checked by their centroids.
coverage: The cerebral cortex of both hemispheres
licence: The FSL licence (free for non-commercial use; https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/Licence), as distributed with FSL and by TemplateFlow. Fetched into the cache, not redistributed.
citation: Makris, N. et al. (2006), Decreased volume of left and total anterior insular lobule in schizophrenia, Schizophr. Res. 83, 155-171; Frazier, J. A. et al. (2005), Am. J. Psychiatry 162, 1256-1265; Desikan, R. S. et al. (2006), NeuroImage 31, 968-980; Goldstein, J. M. et al. (2007), Biol. Psychiatry 61, 935-945.
